correctness.rationale: Exact stationary Green function yields a product Laplace law with correct local-time normalization. Strong-Markov renewal splitting reduces the two oriented squared cross-covariances to zero and a Gaussian-heat-kernel covariance, respectively. The latter is strictly negative for all positive lags by an independent-copy monotone-antitone identity. Analytic erfc integration and zero-frequency resolvent establish its closed form and limiting constants. 66 passed standalone checks independently test the nontrivial identities; numerics are not substituted for infinite proofs.
